install.notes: README.md:42-43 requires a native Linux host, a discrete NVIDIA GPU and Isaac Sim 5.1 with Python 3.11, and README.md:45-60 says Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab must be installed before ./scripts/setup/install.sh builds acados and Pyroki. Nothing was installed or imported here: the gate and the fake backend are pure Python and need no upstream dependency, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task) was not run.
